I can do that — before I remove anything I need a couple quick confirmations:

1) Do you mean the recurring “Release standup” that happens every Thursday (the whole series), or just a single upcoming Thursday occurrence? If you want part of the series removed, should it be deleted from now on (following) or the entire past+future series?
2) Should I send a cancellation notice to attendees, or just remove it from your calendar without notifying them?
3) Do you want me to look up matching events and show you which one I found before I delete it?

Tell me which option you prefer and I’ll proceed.
